messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning: The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles, California, that close at or after 10 PM (i.e., 22). Also wants vegan restaurants in San Francisco, CA, and Seattle, WA. The function vegan_restaurant_find_nearby takes location string and operating_hours optional number default 21. We need to call it for each location with operating_hours=22. The user didn't specify a city for the second request? They said "加州舊金山" which is San Francisco, CA. And "華盛頓州西雅圖" which is Seattle, WA. So we need to call the function twice: once for Los Angeles, CA with operating_hours=22, and once for San Francisco, CA with operating_hours=22. Then also for Seattle, WA with operating_hours=22. Actually the user asked for all three: Los Angeles, San Francisco, Seattle. So we need to call the function three times. The function returns any. We can call it three times. The function signature: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby({location: string, operating_hours?: number}). So we need to call it with location: "Los Angeles, CA" and operating_hours: 22. Then "San Francisco, CA" and operating_hours: 22. Then "Seattle, WA" and operating_hours: 22. We'll do separate calls.
